measure: Concordance with the five-source pipeline decision
denominator_definition: the deliberately stratified lead-author sample from the five-source pipeline at the time of audit
response_type: lead-author oversight concordance; not a representative random sample
note: This check predates the Scopus extension and later objective eligibility corrections; it does not validate the final six-source corpus or the 1,244 Scopus records. Fifteen human-pipeline differences did not receive the planned second-human resolution. It is not accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, or an independent reference standard.
